identity.name: Circa at The Boro
identity.notes: The restaurant-controlled The Boro location page and its exact linked ChowNow storefront both identify Circa at The Boro at 1675 Silver Hill Drive in Tysons. Clarendon, Foggy Bottom, and Navy Yard are separately listed locations and were not merged into this record.

sources.excerpt: The current restaurant-controlled page identifies Circa at The Boro at 1675 Silver Hill Drive, Tysons, VA 22102 and exposes location-specific lunch, dinner, brunch, dessert, happy-hour, zero-proof, and nonalcoholic-beer menus.

The linked restaurant-issued BORO LUNCH 3.25.26 PDF enumerates the complete lunch menu with descriptions and dietary markers. It states that CIRCA is not a gluten-free environment and asks guests to notify servers of allergies or dietary restrictions.
The linked restaurant-issued BORO DINNER 3.25.26 PDF enumerates the complete dinner menu with descriptions and dietary markers, plus the same gluten-environment and allergy-notification statements.

The linked restaurant-issued BORO BRUNCH 3.25.26 PDF enumerates its brunch products and dietary markers. The live HTML brunch surface additionally displays Four Cheese Spinach and Fried Chicken Sandwich while the PDF displays DC Hot Chicken Sandwich.
The restaurant-issued The Boro Spring 2026 beverage PDF lists four zero-proof cocktails and two nonalcoholic beers; alcoholic products were excluded from the POC boundary.
The restaurant-controlled ordering hub separately links The Boro to ChowNow location 56385, distinct from the other CIRCA locations.

The exact restaurant-linked storefront identifies Circa at The Boro at 1675 Silver Hill Dr and exposes 39 consolidated current takeout products across small plates, salads, sandwiches, entrees, flatbreads, desserts, and sides. It provides item descriptions but no comprehensive allergen matrix.

The four targeted search classes surfaced the exact current official page and PDFs, the restaurant-linked ChowNow storefront, and third-party menu copies, but no comprehensive restaurant-issued allergen matrix, nutrition guide, or ingredient guide.

matrixSearch.notes: All four required search classes were completed. Direct restaurant-issued descriptions and dietary markers were retained as positive evidence where support was clear. Empty arrays on unavailable products are not absence claims, and gluten-sensitive/modifiable markers were not converted into allergen-free claims.

reconciliation.notes: Every one of the 94 frozen auditItemKeys is represented exactly once. Twenty-seven compressed PDF-text presentations were mapped pairwise to consolidated products; three OCR/spacing variants were normalized; the rosé is outside the food/nonalcoholic boundary and the concatenated Sandwiches/Margherita string is a parser artifact.

findings.summary: The official location page and exact restaurant-linked ChowNow storefront consistently identify The Boro restaurant at 1675 Silver Hill Drive; other CIRCA locations were excluded.

The complete current union contains 78 consolidated food and nonalcoholic products across live HTML menus, linked Spring 2026 PDFs, dessert, happy hour, zero-proof, nonalcoholic beer, and exact ChowNow. The frozen projection contains compressed duplicates and under-represents the current union.

The live official brunch HTML displays Four Cheese Spinach and Fried Chicken Sandwich, while the simultaneously linked BORO BRUNCH 3.25.26 PDF displays DC Hot Chicken Sandwich and omits Four Cheese Spinach. Both restaurant-issued current presentations were captured in separate complete surfaces and consolidated into the current union.

Current restaurant-issued descriptions and dietary markers support direct positive allergen evidence for many products, but do not constitute a complete matrix. Products without clear direct positives remain unavailable rather than being treated as allergen-free.

All three current food PDFs state that CIRCA is not a gluten-free environment and ask guests to notify servers of allergies or restrictions. This restaurant-level evidence is preserved separately and not generalized as per-item mayContain data.
All four required search classes were completed, but no comprehensive restaurant-issued allergen matrix, nutrition guide, or full ingredient guide was found; matrix status is accurately_unavailable.

proposedChanges: Replace the frozen partial projection with the 78-product consolidated union of all current The Boro food and nonalcoholic HTML, PDF, and exact linked-ChowNow surfaces.

Collapse 27 compressed duplicate presentations, normalize the three OCR/spacing variants, remove the alcohol-only rosé from the POC boundary, and remove the concatenated Sandwiches/Margherita parser artifact.
Preserve the simultaneous live brunch HTML and linked PDF presentations separately, including HTML-only Four Cheese Spinach and Fried Chicken Sandwich plus PDF-listed DC Hot Chicken Sandwich.

Retain only direct restaurant-issued allergen positives, mark undisclosed products unavailable, and keep the restaurant-level gluten cross-contact and allergy-notification statements separate from product mayContain fields.
